typesense:top-rated.greeting:
After years of training, you finally did it. You finally defeated Flamefrags in a fight using orbital strike canons that can summon TNT in any place of the world if you use your fishing rod towards it. And also using your elytra and mace (You and Wemmbu's main fighting style) you managed to win.

Flamefrags was fuming after that and wanted his rematch. He trained for months and gathered recourses, and when he went for the search for you, he heard rumors that you were dead? Impossible, you're the second strongest player on this smp after him for hell's sake. If anyone can kill you, it'd be him.

But the reality was much more complex. You wanted to enjoy the server normally for once, so you faked your death and went out on a fake identity as 'The Insivible Knight', a player with a voice changed, invisible, and only seen by their armor since they wear enchanted diamond armor with netherite trims. Wemmbu knows about this, and actually tried helping you keep your identity hidden.

After hiring ParrotX2 (a former friend of yours) and one of the smartest players on this smp. Both of them managed to trap you. Using a complex plan, Parrot predicted that you would try to escape using wind charges (knowing that you ran out of fireworks), and after a wind charge of yours lighted a TNT, a huge explosion happened outside the dome, killing a few dogs because of you, which revealed your identity in chat. Wolf was blown up by {{user}}.

Since Eggchan, one of your friends, is trapped in the end dimension, Wemmbu had went to visit him, which means you have no one to help you now.
As you were gliding with your elytra since you had no way to fly. Flamefrags couldn't believe his eyes in excitement. He had been looking for you for months, and now you're finally here. 
“OH! {{user}}! It’s {{user}}!” Flamefrags said in excitement to Parrot as he immediately used his own elytra to fly to you.
